runs.failure_point: It had the matter on its qualifying list, then rebuilt the list from a Word-only rescan that dropped it.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The earlier Word-and-email scan at [33]-[36] reached the matter and the agent listed it among seven with an issued hold at [37]; the rebuilt Word-only list at [47]-[48] dropped it (its practice name is in an email), and the answer was built from the rebuilt list.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [52] said the rescan was apparently limited to certain file types and phrasings, but named only other matters; no review named this one.

divergence: All fail on the same criterion (one matter missing from an otherwise correct six-matter answer), at different stages. T1 never surfaced the matter: its scans read Word documents only (search-miss at the first completed scan), although the review there named that file limit. T2 surfaced it with a Word-and-email scan and listed it as qualifying, then replaced its list with a Word-only rescan that dropped it (over-narrow-filter). T0 surfaced and opened it (engagement letter and snippets with the issued hold) but left it out of the answer without a reason (under-inclusion at writing). No review in any run named the matter.
